en.title: L
en.summary: The letter L is the twelfth letter of the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: The sound of el
paragraphs: The letter name is the sound /l/. It makes the sound /l/, like in the word (luna) /lup/, which means wolf. This letter has only one sound in Romanian.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Touch the ridge behind your upper teeth with the tip of your tongue. Let the air flow smoothly around the sides of your tongue. Vibrate your vocal cords with your voice. You can feel your throat buzz when you touch it.

sections.title: Where it appears
paragraphs: This letter always makes the sound /l/ in all standard positions. You can hear it at the start of a word in (lup) /lup/. You also hear it before another consonant in the word (cald) /kald/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not make a dark sound at the end of syllables like in the English word ball. Keep the back of your tongue down. Make a clear, light sound like in the English word leap every time.
